LAHARIKA DEEPTHI T

Journey Expert – Payments & Corporate Banking | GPP | ISO 20022 | CBPR+ | MT/MX | NAM EMEA APAC E2E Payments flow Bengaluru, India | +91 9739159189 | laharikadeepthi@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Self-directed Business Analyst and QA specialist with 7.4 years delivering payment and corporate banking solutions across global markets. Takes full accountability for scope, stakeholder alignment, and quality from elicitation to post-release sign-off across GPP, Liquidity Management, SWIFT MT/MX, and ISO 20022 (CBPR+). Brings the confidence to challenge ambiguity, the discipline to follow through, and a proven record of trusted delivery across APAC, EMEA, and NAM.

CORE TECHNICAL SKILLS

Payment Platforms

GPP (Finastra), PTM, Core Banking Systems, Liquidity management systems, Inhouse Payment initiation channels

Payment Schemes

ISO 20022 / CBPR+, SWIFT MT/MX (pain, pacs, camt), ACH, RTGS, NEFT, SEPA, TT, BKT, Instant Payments, Domestic Payments

Database

Oracle DB, MongoDB, Postgres - SQL

API & Integration

Postman, Swagger, Volpay

QA / Test Tools

Jira (Zephyr, Xray, Confluence), Test Plan & Execution, RTM, Defect Lifecycle

Agile roles

PI Planning, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Scrum

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Australia and New Zealand Bank (ANZ) Nov 2022 – Present Business Analyst – Payments | Bengaluru, India

Project 2: Work Area: Liquidity Management, Application and platform Upgrade

Led JAD workshops to baseline requirements across Interest Optimisation, Sweep Transfers, Notional/Physical Pooling, and Intercompany Loan Models in multi-entity banking environments.

Produced BRDs, FRDs, and INVEST-compliant User Stories; conducted sign-off sessions and traceability audits to maintain scope integrity across stakeholder groups.

Applied MoSCoW and value-stream mapping to prioritise capabilities; delivered As-Is/To-Be BPMN models and change impact assessments to drive Operations and Testing adoption.

Tracked defects in JIRA and facilitated RCA with engineering teams, ensuring closure within agreed SLAs. • Leveraged AI tooling to generate RTMs, Acceptance Criteria, and test artefacts achieving 100% bi-directional traceability with significantly reduced manual effort.

Operated as embedded BA across Agile ceremonies, applied WSJF prioritisation to improve sprint velocity and manage scope creep.

Governed release activities including CIA, regression scoping, RAID log maintenance, BVT coordination, and executive status reporting.

Project 1: Work Area: Payments Initiation channels, Payments flow

Elicited and baselined requirements for domestic and cross-border payment flows (ACH, RTGS, NEFT, BKT, TT, CHEQUE, multi-currency) across GPP and core banking; formalised in BABOK-aligned BRDs and FSDs. ● Produced swimlane diagrams and BPMN maps across GPP, GCP, and PTM to close STP gaps and establish full

payment channel traceability.

Decomposed Epics into Gherkin-formatted User Stories, led Product Owner sign-off to lock scope and minimise late-cycle change.

Executed Oracle SQL queries to trace payment status transitions, validate data integrity, and generate evidence-based stakeholder reports.

Managed JIRA defect logs and chaired RCA sessions, secured stakeholder-confirmed resolution within defined SLAs. ● Defined requirements and acceptance criteria for Automation Anywhere BOT workflows, validated bot behaviour across regression and data integrity cycles.

Owned full UAT lifecycle in strategy, entry/exit criteria, defect triage, and sign-off, produced Release Summary Reports for governance forums.

Maintained RTM with end-to-end traceability from business objectives to UAT sign-off, supplied regulatory coverage evidence with zero gaps.

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Jan 2019 – Nov 2022 QA Analyst – BFSI (Payments) | Bengaluru, India

Project 2 : Corporate Banking – ISO 20022 APAC Migration (CBPR+) Work Area: ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, CBPR+, Cross-Border Payments

Tested ISO 20022 migration for cross-border payments (CBPR+) including MT–MX and MX–MT message format conversions using Volpay and Postman.

Validated SWIFT MT and MX message formats (pain, pacs, camt) in E2E payment flows integrating GPP Fusion, FTI, SWIFT Web Portal, and BigData platforms.

Executed complex payment test scenarios covering domestic and cross-border transactions — ACH, international wire transfers, RTGS, multi-currency, BKT, NEFT, CHEQUE, SEPA.

Designed comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test cases from functional requirements and system architecture documentation.

Acted as primary testing point of contact for facilitators, executors, and validators; coordinated release control and effort estimation.

Maintained 100% business coverage through defect creation, retesting, and tracking to closure.

Project 1 : Corporate Banking – Payment & Service Insights (Real-Time Payments Visibility) Work Area: Cross-Border & Domestic Funds Transfer, ACH, SEPA, Instant Payments, Return of Funds

Orchestrated comprehensive UAT testing for multi-regional payment systems (NAM, EMEA, APAC) covering real-time payment visibility and on-demand payment action capabilities.

Managed end-to-end transaction lifecycle testing through GPP Fusion, BigData ingestion, and Core Banking Systems. • Led cross-functional validation of payment gateway capabilities for credit/debit transactions, bank transfers, ACH, SEPA, Instant Payments, and Return of Funds.

Performed GPP database querying (Oracle DB) to trace transaction states, validate payment processing, and investigate defects.

Designed test strategies and created test plans and test cases aligned to user stories; analysed execution results and logs for functional quality assurance.

Executed Production Verification Testing (PVT) post-deployment ensuring zero leakage to production. • Collaborated with Product Owners, developers, and vendors to clarify requirements, resolve ambiguities, and ensure delivery quality.

CERTIFICATIONS

ISTQB – Foundation Level • Certified Agile Tester • Dynamic Skills Integrated Program – Centre of Innovation & Leadership • Communication Skills – Centre of Innovation & Leadership

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

On-the-Spot Award for critical thinking and delivery excellence in high-impact payment releases. • Client appreciation for sustained delivery support during critical SWIFT ISO 20022 CBPR+ migration testing. • Recognized for cross-application functional expertise across GPP, GCP, PTM, and SWIFT platforms, and for mentoring peers on payment domain knowledge.

EDUCATION Dayanand Sagar College of Engineering, Bengaluru Graduated: June 2018 Bachelor of Engineering – Electronics & Communication
